about: Atlantica Sustainable Infrastructure was a London-headquartered owner of renewable energy, storage, efficient natural gas, transmission and water assets in North America, South America, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, formerly the Abengoa yieldco. It sold power under long-term contracts and was listed on Nasdaq (AY). In 2024 it was acquired by Energy Capital Partners and Atlantica was taken private. B2B with little consumer visibility.

Graphene Manufacturing Group is an Australian cleantech company, based at Richlands in Brisbane, which makes graphene from natural gas using its own process, and has developed graphene aluminium-ion batteries and graphene-enhanced products such as coatings and lubricants. It sells to industrial partners and is working with battery and energy storage customers. Listed on the TSX Venture Exchange. Early commercial B2B brand, with no consumer awareness.

COSCO Shipping Energy Transportation is a Shanghai-based listed subsidiary of COSCO Shipping Group that operates one of the world's biggest fleets of oil and LNG tankers, carrying crude oil, refined products and gas for energy companies. Listed in Shanghai (600026) and Hong Kong (1138). Funding of about 1.5 billion yuan recorded. Customers are oil majors and state energy companies. B2B state-linked shipping company with low consumer brand awareness.

Vedanta Resources is the London-based holding company of Indian natural resources conglomerate Vedanta Limited, controlled by Anil Agarwal. Its subsidiaries produce zinc, lead, silver, aluminium, copper, iron ore, oil and gas, and power, and are building businesses in steel and electronics; Hindustan Zinc and Cairn Oil & Gas are well known. The group operates mainly in India, with additional assets in South Africa and Namibia, and has carried significant debt that it restructured in recent years. Delisted from the London Stock Exchange in 2018. B2B commodities with modest consumer awareness outside India.

wiki.title: Vedanta Resources
wiki.what: Global diversified metals and mining company
wiki.text: Vedanta Resources Limited is a diversified mining company headquartered in London, England. It is the largest mining and non-ferrous metals company in India and has mining operations in Australia and Zambia and oil and gas operations in three countries. Its main products are zinc, lead, silver, oil and gas, iron ore, steel, aluminium and power. It has also developed commercial power stations in India in Odisha and Punjab.

about: Auramet is a Teaneck, New Jersey merchant bank that specialises in physical precious metals, trading, financing, refining and hedging for miners, refiners, jewellery makers, recyclers and industrial customers. It earns trading margins and financing fees, with offices in New York, London, Dubai and elsewhere. Founded in 2010, it is privately held. Recorded funding is about 1.3 billion dollars, probably credit facilities. B2B financial brand with no consumer awareness.

Metal mining company whose Crunchbase entry points to Antofagasta in Chile, consistent with Capstone Copper, a mid-tier copper producer with the Mantos Blancos and Mantoverde mines in Chile and Pinto Valley in Arizona, listed on the TSX (CS) and managed from Vancouver. Sells copper concentrate and cathode to smelters, traders and industrial buyers, so purely B2B. Total funding shown at about $2.49 billion. Not consumer-facing; sponsorship interest would be corporate or reputational rather than commercial. Check which legal entity applies.

about: Anglo American is a London-based global mining company, listed on the London Stock Exchange (AAL) and in Johannesburg, producing copper, iron ore through Kumba and Minas-Rio, premium crop nutrients, and steelmaking coal, and formerly platinum group metals (spun off as Valterra Platinum in 2025). It historically owned De Beers diamonds, which it has been selling. In 2025 it agreed a merger with Teck Resources. Customers are smelters, steelmakers and industrial buyers. B2B miner with little consumer awareness, although De Beers is a consumer brand.

Teck Resources is a Vancouver-based diversified mining company producing copper, zinc and steelmaking coal, with major mines in Canada, Chile and Peru including Highland Valley Copper, Quebrada Blanca and Red Dog. In 2024 it sold its steelmaking coal business to Glencore, and in 2025 it agreed to merge with Anglo American, creating Anglo Teck. Customers are smelters, steel mills and industrial buyers; annual revenue is around C$10 billion. Listed on the TSX and NYSE (TECK). B2B resource brand with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Teck Resources
wiki.text: Teck Resources Limited is a diversified natural resources company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia, that is engaged in mining and mineral development, including coal for the steelmaking industry, copper, zinc, and energy. Secondary products include lead, silver, gold, molybdenum, germanium, indium and cadmium. Teck Resources was formed from the amalgamation of Teck and Cominco in 2001.

about: South Korean steelmaker, one of the world's largest, producing flat and long steel products, stainless steel and specialty alloys, now organised as POSCO Holdings with businesses in steel, batteries and lithium, trading and infrastructure. Founded in 1968 and headquartered in Pohang, it has crude steel capacity of about 40 million tonnes, with plants at Pohang and Gwangyang. Listed in Seoul (005490) and on the NYSE through ADRs. Customers are automakers, shipbuilders and construction firms. Strong brand in Korea, owning the Pohang Steelers football club and sponsoring local sport.

wiki.title: POSCO
wiki.text: POSCO is a South Korean steel manufacturer headquartered in Pohang, South Korea. It had an output of 42,000,000 metric tons of crude steel in 2015, making it the world's Seventh-largest steelmaker by this measure. In 2010, it was the world's largest steel manufacturing company by market value. Also, in 2024, it was named as the world's 233rd-largest corporation by the Fortune Global 500.

about: Dauch Corporation is the renamed American Axle & Manufacturing, a Detroit-based global Tier 1 automotive supplier of driveline, axle, metal forming and, after acquiring Dowlais Group in 2025, the GKN Automotive driveline and powder metal businesses. Customers are carmakers and truck manufacturers worldwide, with revenue of about $10 billion on the combined basis. Listed on NYSE. B2B supplier with no consumer awareness.

about: Space company founded by Elon Musk in 2002, headquartered at Starbase, Texas, building Falcon rockets, Dragon capsules, Starship and the Starlink satellite internet network, which has millions of subscribers worldwide. Privately held, valued at around $400 billion in late 2025, and combined with xAI in 2026. Very high consumer brand visibility. SpaceX employs more than 13,000 people, launches most of the world's orbital missions, and its Starlink service has millions of subscribers.

wiki.title: SpaceX
wiki.text: Space Exploration Technologies Corp., doing business as SpaceX, is an American conglomerate which is a aerospace manufacturer and provider of space transportation, telecommunications, and artificial intelligence (AI) services, headquartered at the Starbase development site in Starbase, Texas. The company operates three primary segments: Space, which develops and flies the Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy, and Starship launch vehicles, as well as the Dragon spacecraft, and conducts more orbital launches annually than any other launch provider ; Connectivity, which operates the Starlink satellite constellation and satellite-based high-speed broadband int

about: Albany, New York company that per the input operates a pure-play quantum wafer foundry, producing wafers for quantum devices using advanced materials and manufacturing methods. No customers, funding history or ownership are given, though the Albany base suggests a link to the local semiconductor research ecosystem. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Ascend Elements is a Westborough, Massachusetts battery materials company that recycles lithium-ion batteries and makes cathode precursor and active materials, with a large Hopkinsville, Kentucky plant. Founded in 2015, it raised $1.7 billion including a large US Department of Energy grant, but has faced delays and cancelled one planned project. Customers are battery makers. B2B cleantech with low consumer awareness.

Pasubio is an Arzignano, Veneto, Italy based provider of premium leather for the automotive, fashion and furniture industries, with a focus on car interiors, supplying leather to carmakers. It is a major tannery group with international operations, and Crunchbase shows funding of about 472 million euros. Specific customers and ownership are not in the input. It is a B2B supplier with limited public brand awareness, but its leather is in well-known cars.

about: Hithium Energy Storage is a Chinese battery maker founded in 2019 and based in Xiamen, Fujian, focused on lithium-ion cells and energy storage systems for utilities, solar and wind developers and commercial users. It produces large-format LFP cells, notably its 300Ah and 1175Ah cells, and sells containerised storage systems worldwide. It has raised significant venture and strategic funding and filed for a Hong Kong listing. B2B supplier with limited public brand awareness.

about: Rongsheng Petrochemical is a major Chinese private petrochemical group, listed in Shenzhen (002493), built around the Zhejiang Petrochemical complex at Zhoushan, a 40 million tonne-per-year integrated refinery and chemicals site. It produces refined oil products, aromatics, olefins, polyester and plastics sold to industrial customers across China. Founded in 1995 and based in Hangzhou, it is among China's largest private chemical groups, with Saudi Aramco holding a minority stake in the Zhoushan venture. B2B commodity business with little consumer brand profile.

Vantage Specialty Chemicals is a US producer of natural-based specialty ingredients, including oleochemicals, emollients and derivatives used in personal care, cosmetics, home care, and industrial and nutrition applications. Headquartered in Deerfield, Illinois, it was formed through a private equity-backed combination of chemical businesses and sells to consumer brands and formulators worldwide. Funding shown is about 900 million dollars. B2B ingredients supplier with no direct consumer brand profile.

about: Chandra Asri is Indonesia's largest integrated petrochemical company, based in Jakarta and listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (TPIA), producing olefins (ethylene and propylene), polyolefins such as polyethylene and polypropylene, styrene monomer and butadiene at its Cilegon complex in Banten. Customers are plastic, packaging, automotive and consumer goods manufacturers in Indonesia and Asia. It is controlled by the Barito Pacific group and, since 2019, also by Thailand's SCG Chemicals, which holds a stake. B2B commodity chemicals producer, little consumer awareness.

Trinseo is a Wayne, Pennsylvania specialty materials company, listed on the NYSE (TSE), formerly part of Dow's styrenics business (Styron) until its sale in 2010 and the rename in 2015. It makes plastics, latex binders, synthetic rubber and engineered materials for automotive, packaging, consumer goods, building and paper customers, with plants in Europe, the US and Asia. Revenue is around $3.5 billion. B2B materials supplier with low consumer awareness.

EQUATE Petrochemical Company is a Kuwaiti petrochemical producer, based in Safat, Kuwait, making ethylene glycol and polyethylene from facilities at Shuaiba and operating the TKOC unit. It is a joint venture of Petrochemical Industries Company (PIC), Dow, Boubyan Petrochemical and Gulf Investment Corporation, selling to plastics and packaging manufacturers in Asia, Europe and the Middle East. It is a large industrial exporter with annual capacity in the millions of tonnes. B2B chemical supplier with no consumer brand awareness.

Lyten is a US battery company, based in San Jose, California, developing lithium-sulfur batteries and 3D graphene materials for electric vehicles, drones, aerospace and defence. In 2025 it agreed to acquire assets of Northvolt in Sweden, Poland and Germany after the Swedish company went bankrupt. It has no mass production yet and has raised more than $360 million in funding. Customers are automakers, aerospace and defence buyers. B2B technology developer with little consumer awareness.

Shanghai Putailai New Energy Technology is a Chinese maker of lithium-ion battery materials, especially graphite anode materials, as well as separators, binders and coated films for battery cells. Customers are major battery producers such as CATL, LG and BYD, and it earns revenue from material sales. Headquartered in Shanghai, it is listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and is one of the leading anode makers in the world, with Crunchbase showing about CN¥2.8 billion raised in 2023. B2B industrial brand with no consumer awareness.

Barito Pacific is an Indonesian conglomerate based in Jakarta, controlled by tycoon Prajogo Pangestu, with interests in petrochemicals through Chandra Asri, the country's largest integrated petrochemical producer, in geothermal and renewable energy through Barito Renewables and Star Energy, and formerly in timber and plantations. Customers are packaging, automotive and industrial manufacturers, and utilities. Listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (BRPT). B2B industrial and energy group with limited consumer awareness, though its owner is prominent in Indonesian business.

British sustainable technologies company, headquartered in London, with roots in precious metals refining from 1817, that makes catalysts, emission control systems for vehicles, battery and hydrogen materials, and platinum group metal services. Customers are carmakers, chemical companies and industrial firms globally, with revenue of several billion pounds. Listed on the London Stock Exchange (JMAT) and agreed in 2025 to sell its Catalyst Technologies unit to Honeywell. Well-known industrial brand, B2B in nature.

wiki.title: Johnson Matthey
wiki.what: British multinational chemicals and sustainable technologies company
wiki.text: Johnson Matthey plc is a British multinational speciality chemicals and sustainable technologies company headquartered in London, England. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

about: Agricultural and construction equipment maker incorporated in the UK and run from Basildon, owning New Holland, Case IH, Case Construction and Steyr, and spun off from the former Fiat Industrial group. Revenue is about $20 billion. Listed on the NYSE and Milan (CNH). Strong brand among farmers and builders, but low consumer awareness. CNH employs about 40,000 people, operates factories in North America, Europe and Brazil, and sells through a global dealer network.

wiki.title: CNH Industrial
wiki.text: CNH Industrial NV is an American-British multinational corporation with global headquarters in Basildon, United Kingdom, but controlled and mostly owned by the Dutch investment company Exor, which in turn is controlled by the Agnelli family. Through its various businesses, CNH Industrial designs, produces, and sells agricultural machinery and construction equipment. Present in all major markets worldwide, CNH Industrial is focused on expanding its presence in high-growth markets, including through joint ventures. In 2019 CNH Industrial employed more than 63,000 people in 67 manufacturing plants and 56 research and development centers. The com

about: Forgent is a Dayton, Minnesota-based designer and manufacturer of electrical distribution equipment for data centres and industrial customers, per the input, with funding of about $5 billion shown, which suggests a large private-equity or growth investment. B2B with no consumer awareness. The business was formerly private and is linked to US data centre electrical buildouts. The input shows funding of about $5 billion and does not give customer names or ownership. Its scale and public visibility should be checked.

wiki.title: Forgent
wiki.text: Forgent plc, formerly known as REACT Energy plc, EQTEC plc, and Kedco plc, is a bioscience energy company operating in the United Kingdom and Ireland which was established in 2005.
